Constraints: Change only the sad eye expression within the atlas. Keep nose, cheek, face width, chin, hair, clothing, neck and background aligned and unchanged. No orange skin halo, lipstick-red colors, heavy near-black brows, white eye flashes, tears, anime eyes, high worried arches, text, labels, borders, extra panels, smoothing or watermark.
